summary: The native delivery probe tests send their probes 2 seconds apart instead of 12, keeping each probe's 10-second deadline, so the outage alert and the recovery come sooner.

replay.detail: Test-only change; no claim, replay or projection change.

rules.detail: No rule, permission or trust change.

compatibility.detail: No wire, CLI or client change.

downtime.detail: Nothing runs differently on installed machines; the probe's own default interval is unchanged.

recovery.detail: Revert the commit to space the test probes 12 seconds apart again.
